verdict.rationale: YYLO is a CLI orchestrator for coding agents, and its docs show a command that has an agent produce an AI-generated summary of the user's repository through the product (`yy pi ... 'Summarize this repository'`). That is only a glancing example of in-product AI insight on user data. Benchmark 'bounded reports' are not documented as AI-generated insights. missing for 10: a documented insights/suggestions feature over Ledger or project data, proactive recommendations, depth of documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: yy pi --no-session 'Summarize this repository. Do not edit files.'
YYLO is a command-line orchestrator for coding agents, repeatable workflows, and receipt-backed repository changes.
